description: List the saved versions of a diagram (one per re-parse, newest first) with the commit each came from and how much it changed. Pass a version's `timestamp` to get_delta to see what it changed. Version history is a Pro feature.

graphId.description: The diagram's graphId, as list_diagrams or get_diagram returns it. The id start_parse returned also works.

name: list_versions
title: List diagram versions
